content.text:
**Finding submitted: INDEMN — missing (critical), confidence 0.93.**

**Investigation.** I read every section of the Agreement (sec-p0000, sec-p0001, sec-1.4, sec-5.4, sec-p0072) and ran targeted searches for "indemn" (regex), "indemnify / hold harmless", "defend / claim / liability / losses / damages / attorneys' fees", "infringe / intellectual property" and "limitation of liability". All returned nothing. The only near-miss language is:

- **Section 9 (Warranties, p0056–p0058)** — mutual organisation/authority/enforceability warranties plus a Globix carve-out; no IP warranty, no indemnity.
- **Section 7.2 (p0045–p0046)** — a mutual advertising covenant that materials will not be "infringing of third party intellectual property rights", but it carries no defence or indemnity remedy.
- **Section 8** — confidentiality obligations only; no remedy for HDI-caused unauthorised access.

There is no Customer-side indemnity either, so this is not a one-sided-indemnity case — the article is genuinely absent, which is walk-away territory ("no Vendor IP indemnity at all") given HDI designs, develops, hosts and operates the Site and supplies the software and admin tools.

**Target level.** I targeted **preferred** rather than fallback deliberately: the Agreement has no liability cap anywhere, so importing the fallback's 3× annual-fees super-cap would create a ceiling on HDI's exposure that does not exist today and would prejudice us. The comment nonetheless offers the fallback exclusions/remedies as a negotiating landing zone.

**Redline.** One `insert_after` p0058 (end of Section 9, immediately before Section 10 General Provisions), numbered 9A, validated `ok:true` with the minimality gate clear. The single clause carries all ten preferred elements: HDI's duty to defend/indemnify the Company **and its affiliates** against third-party claims for (i) IP infringement by the Site, software, deliverables or services, (ii) HDI's breach of law, (iii) HDI-caused unauthorised access to Confidential Information/Content/Site user information, (iv) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct; notice, control of defence and reasonable cooperation; and a Company indemnity expressly confined to Company-supplied Content and our own breach of law, with a "no other indemnification obligation" backstop.
